title: Local polynomial-quotient descent with ring localization base change
statement: Let I be a nonempty directed preorder, Aᵢ a diagram of commutative local rings with local transition maps, and A its commutative-ring colimit with local cocone maps. Let τ:A→T be a local map to a local ring. Let P be a finitely presented commutative A-algebra and W a multiplicative subset, and let f:P→T exhibit T as W⁻¹P, with f on A equal to τ. Then there are i₀∈I and a diagram B of local rings on I≥i₀ with ring-colimit cocone β to T, maps κᵢ:Bᵢ→T equal to βᵢ and local, and local essentially finite type maps τᵢ:Aᵢ→Bᵢ. Ring transitions are local; κᵢτᵢ=τπᵢ and bⱼᵢτᵢ=τⱼaⱼᵢ. For every i≤j in that tail, the canonical map Bᵢ⊗_{Aᵢ}Aⱼ→Bⱼ, x⊗y↦bⱼᵢ(x)τⱼ(y), exhibits Bⱼ as a localization at a multiplicative submonoid. For every i in that tail the canonical map Bᵢ⊗_{Aᵢ}A→T, x⊗y↦κᵢ(x)τ(y), also exhibits its target as a localization at a multiplicative submonoid. No module is part of this assertion. Terminology: ring-colimit [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], finitely presented algebra [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra], essentially finite type [def-weil-pbc-essentially-finite-type-algebra].

proof.text: Shrink P to the base universe using finite-type smallness. Apply the proved finite-presentation descent theorem to obtain one stage model Q₀ and its final pushout square. Over the upper tail define D_i as the pushout of Q₀ along F(i₀)→F(i). Pushout.desc defines transitions and the cocone to the shrink of P; pushout uniqueness proves identities, composition, and naturality. Pushout pasting gives every transition square and every final square.

The upper-tail inclusion is final: any i and i₀ have a common upper bound. Transfer the base colimit to this tail using Functor.Final.isColimitWhiskerEquiv, and obtain the model colimit from its final pushout squares. Its unique isomorphism to P gives e:colimit D≃P, with the structure-map equations. Stage structure maps are finite type by stability under pushout.

Transport the original localization through the shrink equivalence and e to g:colimit D→T. Enlarge the denominator monoid to the complement of the contraction of the maximal ideal of T; precisely those elements map to units. Apply the prime-localization colimit theorem. Transport its cocone to T using the unique localization algebra equivalence. Retain the stage localization maps ιB and their IsLocalization predicates at the contracted primes. These maps are essentially finite type; the cocone maps are local, as compositions of local fraction maps and ring equivalences.

Set τ_i=ιB_i σ_i and κ_i=β_i. The cocone and structure identities prove κ_i τ_i=τ π_i and transition naturality. Locality of κ_i implies locality of B_i. Reflect locality from κ_i τ_i, which equals the composite of the given local maps, to τ_i. Reflect locality from κ_j b_ij=κ_i to each transition. Compose finite type of σ_i with essential finite type of ιB_i.

For i≤j, the colimit identity implies that the transition D_i→D_j maps the contracted-prime complement into the later complement. Apply the localized-pushout tensor theorem to the unlocalized transition pushout, the two stage localization maps, and the localized transition map. Apply it again to the final pushout with target colimit D, the stage localization and g. In the latter formula g e⁻¹ aQ=τ, so the pure tensor maps are exactly the required ones.

theorem exists_limit_module_localization_ring_data
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [Nonempty I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone F) (hc : IsColimit c)
    [∀ i : I, IsLocalRing (F.obj i)] [IsLocalRing c.pt]
    (hF : ∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j), IsLocalHom (F.map (homOfLE h)).hom)
    (hcLocal : ∀ i : I, IsLocalHom (c.ι.app i).hom)
    (T : CommRingCat.{u}) [IsLocalRing T] (τ : c.pt →+* T) [IsLocalHom τ]
    (P : Type p) [CommRing P] [Algebra c.pt P] [Algebra.FinitePresentation c.pt P]
    (W : Submonoid P) (f : P →+* T)
    (hf : f.comp (algebraMap c.pt P) = τ)
    (hT : letI := f.toAlgebra; IsLocalization W T) :
    ∃ i₀ : I,
      ∃ (B : {i : I // i₀ ≤ i} ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (β : B ⟶ (Functor.const _).obj T),
        Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk T β)) ∧
        ∃ (κ : ∀ i : {i : I // i₀ ≤ i}, B.obj i →+* T),
          (∀ i, ∀ x : B.obj i, κ i x = (β.app i).hom x) ∧
          (∀ i, IsLocalRing (B.obj i)) ∧ (∀ i, IsLocalHom (κ i)) ∧
          (∀ (i j : {i : I // i₀ ≤ i}) (h : i ≤ j),
            IsLocalHom (B.map (homOfLE h)).hom) ∧
          ∃ (τ₀ : ∀ i : {i : I // i₀ ≤ i}, F.obj i.1 →+* B.obj i),
            (∀ i, IsLocalHom (τ₀ i)) ∧ (∀ i, (τ₀ i).EssFiniteType) ∧
            (∀ i, (κ i).comp (τ₀ i) = τ.comp (c.ι.app i.1).hom) ∧
            (∀ (i j : {i : I // i₀ ≤ i}) (h : i ≤ j),
              (B.map (homOfLE h)).hom.comp (τ₀ i) =
                (τ₀ j).comp (F.map (homOfLE h)).hom) ∧
            (∀ (i j : {i : I // i₀ ≤ i}) (h : i ≤ j),
              letI := (τ₀ i).toAlgebra
              letI := (F.map (homOfLE h)).hom.toAlgebra
              (∃ φ : B.obj i ⊗[F.obj i.1] F.obj j.1 →+* B.obj j,
                (∀ (x : B.obj i) (y : F.obj j.1),
                  φ (x ⊗ₜ[F.obj i.1] y) =
                    (B.map (homOfLE h)).hom x * τ₀ j y) ∧
                (letI := φ.toAlgebra
                 ∃ U : Submonoid (B.obj i ⊗[F.obj i.1] F.obj j.1),
                   IsLocalization U (B.obj j)))) ∧
            (∀ i : {i : I // i₀ ≤ i},
              letI := (τ₀ i).toAlgebra
              letI : Algebra (F.obj i.1) c.pt := (c.ι.app i.1).hom.toAlgebra
              (∃ φ : B.obj i ⊗[F.obj i.1] c.pt →+* T,
                (∀ (x : B.obj i) (y : c.pt),
                  φ (x ⊗ₜ[F.obj i.1] y) = κ i x * τ y) ∧
                (letI := φ.toAlgebra
                 ∃ U : Submonoid (B.obj i ⊗[F.obj i.1] c.pt), IsLocalization U T)))
